description: This file implements an RNNoise-based audio filter for noise suppression in the Pipecat project. It defines the RNNoiseFilter class, which manages noise reduction processing, resampling, and control frame handling.

classes.name: RNNoiseFilter
classes.description: A class providing real-time noise suppression using RNNoise, with support for resampling and control over filtering state.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the RNNoiseFilter with optional resampler quality setting.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes RNNoise engine with the given sample rate and sets up resampling if needed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disables the RNNoise engine.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Handles control frames to enable or disable filtering.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies RNNoise noise suppression to input audio bytes, with optional resampling.
